notes.title: 1.27.3 Mini Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.27.3:[/h1]
New STANDBOX versions will now include a changelog directly in the menu! Most of the stuff will be shown in there, like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/f9f722adbc367b41e1cb1bf36aa57d9fc1c5088c.png[/img]

[h2]Added severe brain damage[/h2]
We now have "severe brain damage", that is essentially quite similar to regular brain damage, but Stanley will never recover from it. It will happen from times to times from bullet wounds to the brain.
[h2]Improved bullet wounds[/h2]
The effect for bullet wounds has been improved to show a fake 3D parallax effect on the inside of the bullet holes. 
[h2]Halloween removal[/h2]
Halloween is finally gone. Some of the musics have stayed in some hidden places, but besides that, the maps have left. For now. 
[h2]New Inventory UI (drag and drop)[/h2]
New system to change your toolbar! You can now drag and drop from the new inventory menu; which also includes categories and a search bar. 
[h2]Fix sniper bullet color[/h2]
Sniper bullet was weirdly glowy and white. No longer!
[h2]Attempted Fix for low FPS wobble[/h2]
We're trying an experimental workaround to help players with very low-fps. It should improve stability a bit under low fps (<40fps) so that Stanley doesn't oscillate and wobble and fall on his own after a while.

Not listed, also a fix for the grenade bug (only in the playtest) and an issue where Stanley wouldn't wake up after being knocked-out.

[h1]STANDBOX SDK:[/h1]
STANDBOX SDK has been added to all the STBX owners on Steam! You no longer need to request specific access to it. You WILL need to have Unreal Engine 5.1 installed to be able to do anything with it though, so do keep that in mind.

Regarding the Workshop, it is currently under open-playtest. To join it, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/STBXBETA]you will have to join the STBX BETA group on Steam[/url], and add the "-modding" launch option to STBX from the Steam launch options.

The reason why we're keeping it under limited access is to finish filling it up a bit but also to make sure there's no issue we missed before we make a big announcement to release it. You're welcome to come check it out if you don't want to wait though!

notes.title: Working on the next update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] - LANDMINES
[*] - PRESET SYSTEM REFORGE
[*] - A TOOL/STUDIO MAP FOR GREENSCREENS
[*] - A NEW "ADVANCED" SECTION TO CHANGE LEVELS
[*] - REWORKING THE UI
[*] - MAYBE A TUTORIAL?
[*] - MAYBE MORE
[/list]

[h2]LANDMINES:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=kA79sU-TSZQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ADVANCED LEVEL SELECTION + NEW STUDIO MAP:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=08Lc4NN7VrM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]NEW LEVEL SELECTION:[/h3]
Both for alternate maps or variants that shouldn't be on the main page, or for modders to add their maps! Alternatively, for modders/devs or investigative players, you can run the maps directly by using the name of the map if you know it.

[h3]GREENSCREEN STUDIO:[/h3]
A new map for the creative players! I've seen some players try to do creative things, both with photoshops or video editing. That map will make it easier. You have a controllable light emitting screens, that you can use color and light properly (to better fit whatever you are going to use it for) and a greenscreen/chromakey shader, that you can use to hide the background with a color of your choosing, so that you can easily chromakey it away in your favorite editor (photoshop, video editing software etc...)

[h3]PRESET SYSTEM REFORGE:[/h3]
The entire preset system has been redone, to be more powerful and to work with anything that will be added in the game in the future, including mods! Instead of having access to a few hardcoded values, you'll now have access to ANY variables, allowing you to modify things we didn't even consider! Maybe you can do something cool we didn't plan for! Maybe you can break the game! The power should be in your hands. It's not modding yet, but it already gives you a bit more control in the sandbox rules.

It is already accessible on the public-beta branch, but it will release on the main version next update.

[h3]others:[/h3]
Beside that, I'd like to rework the UI, add a tutorial (I see a lot of people, even big streamers, miss a lot of core features of the game!), and I have a few other things planned, but we'll see how much actually gets in the next patch.

At the very least, you'll definitely get the new studio map, the level selection menu and the preset reforge. And the landmines, OF COURSE.

In the background, even if you can't see it, we're still working on the core code of the game, to make it ready for modding, and some other features we haven't mentioned publicly yet. 

Let me know what you think, I'm always happy to get feedback! [url=https://discord.com/servers/standbox-1072265695297019996]And don't forget, I post way more updates on the Discord, so feel free to join if you want to see everyday details about what I'm working on, or participate in some events that might get you free keys and other rewards!
[/url]
See ya soon!

notes.title: Update 1.022
notes.notes:
This update will modify a few things, including how the animations are handled, so you may notice a few different behaviors from Stanley. It was done so that in the long term things become easier to maintain and improve.

[h2]Here's the full list of changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Physics change
[*] Stanley can now die from head trauma (single very powerful, or repeated over time)
[*] Fix for the blood loss speed
[*] Fix for inconsistent blood size (TheRoom boxes and the bottom of TheBunker)
[*] Fix for missing limp and tetraplegia behaviors (got broken with the physics change in 1.021)
[/list]

Stanley should now be more reactive, easier to kill from blunt impact, and lose blood at proper speed. I expect their might be some other issues popping up due to the physics change, but those will get fixed as they get reported!

Have fun.

notes.title: BETA TESTING 1.02 UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b][h2]This is currently being playtested. You can join the playtest by simply switching the beta branch to "Public Beta"[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324293/c3da6549e9b537c3acea2ef841163118680a1edc.png[/img]

This update is mostly about fixing some issues with 1.01, bringing the first batch of achievements (more to come!) and placing the groundwork for the stress and breathing system. Oh and also, new arteries, and heart attack!

[h1]1.02 features:[/h1]
[h2]Additions[/h2]
- Breathing (no lungs wounds at the time)
- Stress (affects heart rate and breathing speed)
- Heart Attack when Stanley is in too high-stress for too long. (Some Stanleys are cardiac and some aren't. It's pretty rare)
- New Femoral Artery (very high flow aretery that can kill stanley in a few seconds, like the jugular in the neck)
- You can now turn off or change dismemberment chance.
- You can now alter AKsebben settings like the other weapons.
- Achievements !!!
[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Some behaviors alterations (mainly regarding animations)
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Some fixes for a few issues reported with 1.01 (white doors, boxes not receiving blood, an easter egg appearing too often)
- Fixed the "flying blood" issue

[b][h3]/!\ pressing delete removes ALL your STANDBOX achievement for playtesting purposes, it will be removed when the final version is released, be careful /!\ [/h3][/b]
